# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(IRanges)
  library(GenomicRanges)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp")
smoking_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp_smoking")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "annotation_functions.R"))
```

# Define Functions

## Get Combp Data

```{r func_load}
# prefix is "" for the primary analysis and "Smoking_Adjusted_" for the
# smoking-adjusted analysis (both BACON-corrected in 02b)
get_bacon_stats_path <- function(label, prefix = "") {
  file.path(
    save_dir,
    "linear_model",
    paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats_bacon_", label, ".csv")
  )
}

# combp_dir is data/combp/ for the primary analysis and
# data/combp_smoking/ for the smoking-adjusted analysis (see 02c)
get_combp_inputs <- function(combp_dir = data_dir) {
  fname <- file.path(combp_dir, "combp_input.bed")

  combp_df <- read.table(fname, header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
    dplyr::select("probe", chr = "chrom", "start", "end")

  combp_df
}

get_combp_result <- function(label, combp_dir = data_dir) {
  fname <- file.path(
    combp_dir, paste0(label, ".regions-t.bed")
  )

  combp_df <- readr::read_table(fname) %>%
    dplyr::rename(chr = "#chrom") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      DMR = paste0(.data$chr, ":", .data$start, "-", .data$end)
    )

  combp_df
}

get_probe_annotations <- function(label, prefix = "") {
  res_df <- read.csv(get_bacon_stats_path(label, prefix)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = ifelse(.data$estimate_bacon > 0, "+", "-")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      probe = "CpG",
      "direction",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Group",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Name",
      "Relation_to_Island"
    )

  res_df
}
```

## Get Signif Data

```{r func_signif}
get_signif_dmr <- function(label) {
  dmr_ls <- read.csv(
    file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", paste0(label, "_DMRs.csv"))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::pull("cpgs_in_region") %>%
    stringr::str_split(",") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique()

  dmr_ls
}

get_signif_cpgs <- function(label) {
  cpg_ls <- read.csv(get_bacon_stats_path(label)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$pvalue_bacon < 1e-5,
      .data$IQR >= 2
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull("CpG")

  cpg_ls
}
```

## Get GREAT Annotation

```{r func_great}
make_dmr_granges <- function(dmr_df) {
  dmr_df %>%
    GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
      start.field = "start",
      end.field = "end",
      seqnames.field = "chr"
    )
}

# "GENE (+distance)" for each gene associated with one region, joined by ";"
format_great_genes <- function(genes, dist_to_tss) {
  g <- ifelse(
    dist_to_tss > 0,
    paste0(genes, " (+", dist_to_tss, ")"),
    paste0(genes, " (", dist_to_tss, ")")
  )

  paste0(g, collapse = ";")
}

# Add the GREAT region-gene associations to dmr_df as GREAT_annotation
add_great_annotation <- function(dmr_df, region_genes_df) {
  great_annotation <- lapply(
    seq_along(region_genes_df$annotated_genes),
    function(i) {
      format_great_genes(
        region_genes_df$annotated_genes[[i]],
        region_genes_df$dist_to_TSS[[i]]
      )
    }
  )

  great_df <- region_genes_df %>%
    dplyr::select("seqnames", "start", "end") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(GREAT_annotation = unlist(great_annotation))

  dmr_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(great_df, by = c("chr" = "seqnames", "start", "end"))
}

get_great_annot_local <- function(dmr_df) {
  region_genes_df <- rGREAT::great(
    gr = make_dmr_granges(dmr_df),
    gene_sets = "GO:BP",
    tss_source = "GREAT:hg38"
  ) %>%
    rGREAT::getRegionGeneAssociations(by_middle_points = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  add_great_annotation(dmr_df, region_genes_df)
}

# Same annotation using the online GREAT server
get_great_annot <- function(dmr_df) {
  region_genes_df <- make_dmr_granges(dmr_df) %>%
    rGREAT::submitGreatJob(genome = "hg38") %>%
    rGREAT::getRegionGeneAssociations() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  add_great_annotation(dmr_df, region_genes_df)
}
```

## Merge Data

```{r func_merge}
add_probes <- function(input_df, result_df, annot_df) {
  input_gr <- input_df %>%
    GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame()

  result_gr <- result_df %>%
    GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame()

  overlap_df <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(result_gr, input_gr) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  cpg_df <- input_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(index = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select("probe", "index") %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(overlap_df, by = c("index" = "subjectHits")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(annot_df, by = "probe") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$queryHits) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      direction = paste0(.data$direction, collapse = ""),
      cpgs_in_region = paste0(.data$probe, collapse = ","),
      UCSC_RefGene_Group = filter_collapse(.data$UCSC_RefGene_Group, collapse = ";"),
      UCSC_RefGene_Name = filter_collapse(.data$UCSC_RefGene_Name, collapse = ";"),
      Relation_to_Island = filter_collapse(.data$Relation_to_Island, collapse = ";")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  result_df <- result_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(index = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(cpg_df, by = c("index" = "queryHits")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-"index") %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "DMR",
      "n_probes",
      `P-value` = "z_p",
      `Sidak-P` = "z_sidak_p",
      "direction",
      "cpgs_in_region",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Group",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Name",
      "Relation_to_Island",
      "GREAT_annotation"
    )

  result_df
}
```

## Wrapper Functions

```{r func_wrapper}
# The primary analysis keeps only significant DMRs. The smoking-adjusted
# analysis (filter_dmrs = FALSE) keeps every region, so that each primary DMR
# can be matched to its overlapping smoking-adjusted region in 03b.
combp_wrapper <- function(
    label, prefix = "", combp_dir = data_dir, filter_dmrs = TRUE
) {
  input_df <- get_combp_inputs(combp_dir)
  # Stanford's Great host was down. Running GREAT annotation locally
  result_df <- get_combp_result(label, combp_dir) %>%
    get_great_annot_local()
  annot_df <- get_probe_annotations(label, prefix)
  dmr_df <- add_probes(input_df, result_df, annot_df)

  if (!filter_dmrs) {
    write.csv(
      dmr_df,
      file = file.path(
        save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", paste0(prefix, label, "_DMRs.csv")
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    return(invisible(dmr_df))
  }

  dmr_df <- dmr_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_probes >= 3) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$`Sidak-P` < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      uni_dir = sapply(
        .data$direction, function(x) {
          paste0(unique(stringr::str_split(x, "")[[1]]), collapse = "")
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(nchar(.data$uni_dir) == 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(-"uni_dir")

  write.csv(
    dmr_df,
    file = file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", paste0(label, "_DMRs.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

signif_wrapper <- function(label) {
  dmr_ls <- get_signif_dmr(label)
  cpg_ls <- get_signif_cpgs(label)

  both_ls <- intersect(dmr_ls, cpg_ls)

  signif_df <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      cpgs = dmr_ls[!(dmr_ls %in% both_ls)],
      Sources = "CpG in DMR"
    ),
    data.frame(
      cpgs = cpg_ls[!(cpg_ls %in% both_ls)],
      Sources = "individual CpG"
    )
  )

  if (length(both_ls) > 0) {
    signif_df <- rbind(
      data.frame(
        cpgs = both_ls,
        Sources = "DMR and Individual CpG"
      ),
      signif_df
    )
  }

  write.csv(
    signif_df,
    file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", paste0(label, "_mQTLs_inputs.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Add Probes to DMRs

```{r run_wrapper}
for (label in c("interact", "ptau")) {
  combp_wrapper(label)
  combp_wrapper(
    label,
    prefix = "Smoking_Adjusted_",
    combp_dir = smoking_dir,
    filter_dmrs = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Get Signif Probes

```{r run_signif}
signif_wrapper("interact")
signif_wrapper("ptau")
```

# Merge Comb-p to CpG Statistics

```{r run_merge}
dmr_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_DMRs.csv")
) %>%
  dplyr::select("DMR", "P.value", "Sidak.P", CpG = "cpgs_in_region") %>%
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim("CpG", delim = ",")
cpg_df <- read.csv(get_bacon_stats_path("interact"))

res_df <- dmr_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cpg_df, by = "CpG")

write.csv(
  res_df,
  file = file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_DMR_CpG_Mapping.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
